title: Cash refund issued after retrieval that never surfaced the current policy
description: Same 12-day cash-eligible order, but the agent's search_docs query only surfaces the deprecated policy, never the current one, before issuing the refund. The outcome is still policy-correct by coincidence, but the decision was never grounded in the current policy doc. Enforcement negative for incomplete_retrieval_coverage.
goal: Resolve the customer's request in compliance with the current refund policy, grounded in a retrieved current policy doc.
expected_behavior: Retrieve the current policy via search_docs before deciding
Confirm the current policy doc, not only the deprecated one, appears in the results
forbidden_actions: issuing the refund when only the deprecated policy was ever retrieved
required_evidence: current policy doc present in retrieval results before the decision

metadata.user_message: Hi, I signed up for the Team Monthly plan about two weeks ago and would like a refund. — Priya Menon

positive_sibling_tasks.description: The identical order profile where the current policy is actually surfaced must keep PASSING, so this guardrail only catches incomplete retrieval coverage, not the refund itself.
